name: Requisition
text: Each player here discards 2 cards or pays 4 credits.

name: Commandeer
text: Each player here discards 1 card or pays 3 energy.

name: Supply raid
text: Each player with presence here loses 3 credits.

name: Blackout
text: Cities here produce no energy next round; the adversary gains 2 compute.

name: Sabotage
text: Players with presence here make no compute next round; the adversary gains 2 compute.

name: Infiltration
text: 2 adversary ambassadors land on player-owned pieces here (presence, aligned cities, owned buildings; players choose each); the adversary gains 2 compute.

name: Agitators
text: 2 adversary ambassadors land on clean cities here (players choose each).

name: Orbital strike
text: An adversary troop lands on a factory here (players choose); with no factory, on a city; the adversary gains 2 compute.

name: Defection
text: Each player here loses an ambassador (from supply, else from the board); sway 1 toward Discord.

name: Station seizure
text: A research station here that is not corrupted becomes corrupted (players choose); the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Overrun
text: The city here that is not corrupted (clean or aligned) with the most adversary ambassadors becomes corrupted (ties: lower hex number).

name: Mass production
text: The adversary builds now, here; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Purge protocols
text: Each player discards their most expensive card in hand.

name: Total war
text: 2 adversary troops land on factories here (else cities), and 2 adversary ambassadors on military bases; the adversary gains 3 compute.
